sampling.nodata_rule: a candidate any of whose samples has a nodata or 0.0 pixel among its four neighbours is dropped whole
sampling.structure_rule: a bridge, tunnel or covered candidate is read at its two endpoints only and interpolated linearly by distance between them

dem_planned_with.operation: axis order change (2D) + Inverse of S-JTSK to WGS 84 (3) + Krovak East North (Greenwich)

transform.operation: axis order change (2D) + Inverse of S-JTSK to WGS 84 (5) + Krovak East North (Greenwich)
